specification.selection: One bounded refinement round; fresh six-layer D2NN+OEO from random initialization, original lr0.002 and maximum30 epochs. Preserve accepted weakaug run, checkpoint and all predictions. Each candidate differs from weakaug by one small training parameter: EMA0.95->0.97 or label smoothing0.02->0.03. Select minimum full validation balanced NLL. Test selected candidate once only if NLL <0.9679116606712341-0.0005. Otherwise retain accepted run and do not test either candidate. No test-score-driven choice, accuracy cap or required architecture ranking; exploratory validation-adaptive development.
